en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by my father, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Muhammed bin Yahya al-‘Attar, from Ahmad bin Muhammed bin ‘Isa, from Abu Hashim al-Ja’fari, that he said: I asked Abu Ja’far the Second, peace be upon him: What is the meaning of the One?
He said: The One upon which it is gathered with all the tongues, in Oneness.
